title: Aromatic Slovakian Bread Toast
description: A pungent and snappy Slovakian dish featuring milk chocolate and double-rise bread, perfect for a cozy evening, and easily made vegan-friendly by substituting the chocolate.

ingredients.name: milk chocolate
ingredients.notes: vegan milk chocolate for vegan version

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.notes: or maple syrup for vegan version

instructions: Slice the double-rise bread into 1-inch thick slices.
In a small bowl, mix together the almond butter, honey, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and sea salt.
Spread the almond butter mixture onto each bread slice.
Melt the milk chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Drizzle the melted chocolate over the bread slices.
Sprinkle the chopped walnuts over the chocolate.
Place the bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 5 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
